title: Retro-Tahyon competing-model benchmark for minimum witness identifiability
question: What minimum prospective witness set would separate coarse competing cause classes derived from the Retro-Tahyon hypothesis library without promoting archival discussion into physical truth?

source_gate_roles.TOPA-RT-H1: Prospective pre-event holdout/leakage gate; separates ordinary/leakage null from retro-information hypotheses only if the preregistered effect survives.
source_gate_roles.TOPA-RT-H2: Temporal-kernel validity gate; retained as control, with no hard cause-class edge because the dossier provides no carrier-specific temporal kernel.
source_gate_roles.TOPA-RT-H3: DAT-versus-force discriminator; separates information-selection from physical-channel hypotheses.
source_gate_roles.TOPA-RT-H4: Carrier-identity discriminator; tachyon-specific claim requires an independent tachyon-specific physical observable, not only anomalous statistics.
source_gate_roles.TOPA-RT-H5: UAP bridge gate; unavailable in the current benchmark because the source records no direct UAP-tachyon-retrocausality link and the NARA bulk byte scan remains incomplete.

cost_policy.meaning: Every prospective test design costs one abstract unit so the solver minimizes witness count. This is not an empirical resource/time/money estimate.

why.TOPA-RT-H1: Required to separate ordinary causal/leakage explanations from the retro-information family.
why.TOPA-RT-H3: Required to separate DAT information-selection from physical-channel hypotheses.
why.TOPA-RT-H4: Required to separate a tachyon-specific carrier from generic advanced-time physical-channel and non-carrier alternatives.

non_selected_but_preserved.TOPA-RT-H2: Important preregistration/temporal-shape control but not a hard cause-class separator at the current evidence granularity.
non_selected_but_preserved.TOPA-RT-H5: Cross-domain UAP extension, explicitly blocked from core cause promotion under the current dossier.

validation_requirements: Source artifact id and epistemic status must match the canonical Retro-Tahyon registry file.
All five TOPA-RT gates must exist in the source with matching names.
Source must still report direct_uap_tachyon_link_found=false and byte_level_bulk_scan=NOT_COMPLETED.
R4.1 exact solver must return a unique unit-cost minimum H1+H3+H4 with zero unresolved pairs.
Leave-one-out must show each of H1, H3 and H4 is required for that selected solution.
No result may upgrade the source status into a physical retrocausality, tachyon or UAP claim.
next_if_green: Use R4.2/R4.3 only after outcome semantics or calibrated likelihoods are prospectively defined; do not invent probabilities from archival text.
